summary: Focused validation of Master Dashboard 'Fix Employee Menus' panel (frontend) + its 3 admin/integrity endpoints (backend). All 8 pytest cases pass. UI flows verified end-to-end (panel visible, per-employee check for OK & NO_SITE, scan report, backfill mutation, and single-site auto-fallback post-backfill). One minor UX bug discovered: the backfill success message is set and then immediately cleared by runReport() which does setMsg(''), so users never see the '✓ Fixed N employee(s)…' confirmation.

ui_bugs.issue: runBackfill() sets success msg with setMsg('✓ Fixed …') then awaits runReport() which starts with setMsg(''), wiping the confirmation before it renders. Users see the report refresh but no visible success text (fem-message never appears). Fix: either call runReport() first then set msg, or make runReport accept a `preserveMsg` flag, or drop the setMsg('') in runReport.

action_items: Fix FixEmployeeMenus backfill success message being clobbered by runReport() setMsg(''). Simplest patch: remove `setMsg('')` from runReport (only clear msg in runCheck/runBackfill entry) OR set msg AFTER awaiting runReport.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is 745 lines — FixEmployeeMenus (110+ lines) should be extracted into src/pages/master/components/FixEmployeeMenus.jsx.
runReport clears msg unconditionally, which causes the backfill success toast to disappear immediately (see UI bug above). Chain-callers must be able to opt out of msg reset.

rca of the issue: runBackfill (Dashboard.js:436-446) sequence: setMsg('✓ Fixed …') → await runReport(). runReport (line 426-434) begins with setMsg(''), synchronously overwriting the success text. Because React batches within the same tick and the runReport network call is fast (<200ms), the user sees only the empty-msg state. Repro: click Auto-fix sites → observe no fem-message renders, but fem-report still updates (backfill did succeed server-side; verified via Scan summary reflecting the change and via backend pytest). Mitigation: delete `setMsg('')` from runReport OR set the ✓ message AFTER `await runReport()` in runBackfill.
